source_boundary.true_mmaudio_attempt: Only rows with readable=true and video_conditioned=true may be called true V2A.
source_boundary.fallback_mmaudio_baseline: Fallback/control baseline candidates must not be described as true video-conditioned MMAudio.
source_boundary.control_seed: Rule/control candidates are valid system candidates but not model-generated V2A.
source_boundary.repair_seed: Repair candidates are valid for repair/reranker testing, not proof of true V2A.
